title: Avoid COPY case-matching lowercase allocation
description: Replace COPY format and boolean field to_ascii_lowercase matching with direct ASCII case-insensitive comparisons.

criteria: COPY FORMAT CSV/TEXT parsing no longer allocates lowercase format strings
COPY boolean field parsing no longer allocates lowercase field strings
Mixed-case CSV, TEXT, TRUE/T, and FALSE/F inputs keep their existing behavior
Unsupported COPY FORMAT error text remains unchanged
COPY SQL and PostgreSQL COPY STDIN regressions pass

notes: FORMAT parsing computes is_csv with eq_ignore_ascii_case and checks TEXT with the same direct comparison.
copy_field_to_value now checks TRUE/T and FALSE/F with eq_ignore_ascii_case after the existing null, integer, and float parsing.
The fallback string branch still preserves the original field bytes via field.to_string().
